member.summary: A set of extension methods which allow chaining of methods in a nice fluent, english sentence like chain or flow. In order to be chained a method need only return a Task Of OneOf Ts or Tf, where Ts == Success and Tf == Failure.

member.summary:
Extension method which enables method chaining. Each method in the chain must accept a Ts and return a Task<OneOf<Ts, Tf>>, where Ts == Success and Tf == Failure.
The result of the Task is evaluated and if it contains a Tf, that Tf will be immediately returned.
Otherwise, the Ts is passed to the Func to be executed and the new result is returned.

member.returns: A Task<OneOf<Ts, Tf>>, which enables these extension methods to form a chain.

member.summary:
Extension method which enables method chaining. This version evaluates an additional Func and only invokes if it returns True.
Each method in the chain must accept a Ts and return a Task<OneOf<Ts, Tf>>, where Ts == Success and Tf == Failure.
The result of the Task is evaluated and if it contains a Tf, that Tf will be immediately returned.
Otherwise, if the func evaluates to True, the Ts is passed to the Func to be executed and the new result is returned. If the func evaluates to False, the Ts is returned.
The Func enables tidying up tasks to be performed if fails.

member.summary:
Extension method which enables method chaining. This version enables looping over a collection of s.
Each method in the chain must accept a Ts and return a Task<OneOf<Ts, Tf>>, where Ts == Success and Tf == Failure.
The result of the Task is evaluated and if it contains a Tf, that Tf will be immediately returned.
Otherwise, Items can be fetched and called for each Item. If returns a Tf for any item, then that will be immediately returned. Otherwise, successful results are each passed to the next task and the loop continues until the final result is returned. The Func enables tidying up tasks to be performed if any tasks fail.

member.summary:
Extension method which enables method chaining. This method accepts an array of tasks which will be executed in parallel. This method will return once all tasks have completed.
Each method in the chain must accept a Ts and return a Task<OneOf<Ts, Tf>>, where Ts == Success and Tf == Failure.
Please note, the Ts is passed into each task by ref, so care must be taken around any mutation of any state on the Ts.
This library cannot know how to merge the result of each task. A strategy must be provided. Another overload of this method provides a naive default merging strategy.
member.typeparam: Represents success, also likely contains any required state/results for processing in the chain.
Represents a failure at some point in the chain.
member.param: The resulting Task of the previous link in the chain.
A func which is passed the original Ts and a list of results from the Tasks, it should decide how to merge the results once they have all returned i.e. what to return from this method.
A list a tasks to execute in parallel.
member.returns: A Task<OneOf<Ts, Tf>>, which enables these extension methods to form a chain.
